leo-mumbai-new-york.name: Mumbai–New York · baseline
leo-mumbai-new-york.description: The same eight-satellite constellation and recurring traffic used by the default Simulation setup.
leo-mumbai-new-york.focus: Baseline moving LEO contacts and store-carry-forward delivery

leo-sparse-constellation.name: Mumbai–New York · sparse constellation
leo-sparse-constellation.description: Keeps the same stations, orbits, bundle, and traffic, but uses four of the baseline satellites.
leo-sparse-constellation.focus: How fewer satellites affect contact availability and delivery

leo-limited-buffers.name: Mumbai–New York · limited buffers
leo-limited-buffers.description: Keeps the baseline constellation and traffic while reducing relay buffers to one bundle each.
leo-limited-buffers.focus: How finite satellite storage affects recurring bundle delivery

leo-high-traffic.name: Mumbai–New York · high traffic
leo-high-traffic.description: Keeps the baseline constellation but generates 100 MB bundles every 15 simulated seconds.
leo-high-traffic.focus: How higher offered load affects delivery and queueing

leo-expanded-constellation.name: Mumbai–New York · expanded constellation
leo-expanded-constellation.description: Adds eight moving satellites to the same baseline orbital setup and traffic pattern.
leo-expanded-constellation.focus: How a larger constellation changes generated contact opportunities

orbital_model: circular two-body propagation around a spherical Earth with sampled line-of-sight and minimum-elevation contacts
replication_note: Five deterministic paired phase realizations for each controlled preset; descriptive results only, no significance test.
